_about: UI-E2E-2: the VITE_* environment the SIGNED-IN ui-e2e build is made with (.github/workflows/ui-e2e.yml, job ui-e2e-signed-in). It is buildEnv.json plus ONE key, VITE_E2E_FIREBASE_EMULATOR=1, which points Firebase Auth and Firestore at the local emulator (services/firebaseClient.ts, services/firestoreSdk.ts). THIS IS THE ONLY FILE IN THE REPO THAT MAY SET THAT KEY (scripts/ops/e2e_emulator_absent.mjs --sources fails otherwise); it is never set in Vercel or Railway. When buildEnv.json changes, change this file the same way (the signed-in job checks they differ only by that key).
